mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_alarm_schedules ( username, calendar_id, schedule_time, status, alarm_type, gubn_id, message ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{calendarId}, #{scheduleTime}, #{status}, #{alarmType}, #{gubnId}, #{message} )
mapper.select: SELECT ns.alarm_schedules_id as id, ns.username, ns.calendar_id as calendarId, ns.schedule_time as scheduleTime, ns.status, ns.alarm_type as alarmType, ns.gubn_id as gubnId, ns.message, c.calendar_title as calendarTitle FROM tbl_alarm_schedules ns JOIN tbl_calendar c ON ns.calendar_id = c.calendar_id WHERE ns.status = 'PENDING' AND STRCMP(DATE_FORMAT(ns.schedule_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), DATE_FORMAT(#{currentTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) IN (-1, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_alarm_schedules SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alarm_schedules_id = #{alarm_schedules_id}
